झ: झ The ninth consonant of the Nāgarī alphabet; the aspirate of the preceding letter, and corresponding in power to Jh.

झ mfn. (झः झा झं) 1 Asleep, sleeping. 2 Lost, destroyed. m. (झः) 1 A name of VṚHASPATI, preceptor of the gods. 2 A name of the chief of the Daityas or demons. 3 Sound, or a sort of sound like the splashing of water, or the clashing of cymbals, jangling, clanging, &c. 4 High wind. 5 A stray, a thing lost or mislaid. 6 Playing a tune, beating time. f. (झा) The descent of a cascade, a water fall. E. झट to collect, affix ड.
झङ्कार: झङ्कार m. (-रः) A low inarticulate sound, as the buzzing of bees, &c. E. झं, and कार a making.
झञ्झन: झञ्झन n. (-नं) An indistinct noise, like the jangling of metal ornaments, a ringing, a rattling, &c.
झञ्झा: झञ्झा f. (-ञ्झा) 1 Wind, wind and rain, a hurricane, a gale. 2 A sharp clanging sound, jangling. 3 Raining in large drops. 4 A stray, any thing lost.
झञ्झानिल: झञ्झानिल m. (-लः) Wind with rain, a high wind in the rainy season, a typhoon or the sort of tempest frequent during the south-west monsoon. E. झञ्झा heavy rain, and अनिल wind; also झञ्झामरुत्, &c.
झञ्भ्कावात: झञ्भ्कावात m. (-तः) Wind with rain, a storm, a squall. E. झञ्झा heavy rain, and वात wind.
झट: झट r. 1st cl. (झटति) To clot, to be entangled, (as hair:) see जट.
झटा: झटा f. (-टा) A plant, (Flacourtia cataphracta.) E. झट to be entangled, affix अच्.
झटि: झटि m. (-टिः) A small tree, a shrub, a bush. E. झट to be entangled, इ Uṇādi aff.
झटिति: झटिति ind. Quickly, speedily, instantly. E. झटि entangling, confusing, affix क्तिच्; also जटिति.
झनत्कार: झनत्कार m. (-रः) The clanging of metallic ornaments, &c. E. झनत् imitative sound, &c. कार making.
झम: झम (उ) झमु r. 1st cl. (झमति) To eat: see जमु, &c.
झम्प: झम्प mf. (-म्पः-म्पा) Jumping, springing, plunging. E. झं imitative sound, and पत to fall, affix ड.
झम्पाक: झम्पाक m. (-कः) A monkey or ape. E. झम्प, and अक to go.
झम्पारु: झम्पारु m. (-रुः) A monkey, an ape. E. झम्प plunging, and ऋ to go, उण् aff.
झम्पाशिन्: झम्पाशिन् m. (-शी) A kingfisher. E. झम्प plunging, and अश to eat, affix णिनि.
झम्पिन्: झम्पिन् m. (-म्पी) A monkey, an ape. E. झम्प springing, इनि aff.
झर: झर m. (-रः) f. (-रा or -रिः-री) A cascade, a water-fall. f. (-री) A river. E. झॄ to waste or decay, affix अप्, fem. affix टाप्, इन् or ङीष्; also निर्झर.
झर्च: झर्च r. 6th cl. (झर्चति) 1 To say. 2 To blame; to abuse or menace; also झर्छ, झर्ज, &c.
झर्छ: झर्छ r. 6th cl. (झर्छति) 1 To say. 2 To blame, to abuse or menace; also झर्च.
झर्ज: झर्ज r. 6th cl. (झर्जति) 1 To say, to speak. 2 To censure, to blame.
झर्झ: झर्झ r. 1st and 10th cls. (झर्झति झर्झयति) 1 To speak or say. 2 To censure or reprove. r. 1st cl. (झर्झति) To kill or hurt.
झर्झर: झर्झर mf. (-रः-री) A sort of drum. m. (-रः) 1 The Kali yug, the present Yug or age of the world. 2 The name of a river. f. (-रा) A whore. n. (-रं) A sound as of splashing or dropping. E. झर्झ an imitative sound like that of water splashing, &c. and र what makes, from रा with ड affix, or झर्झ to censure, and अरन् Uṇādi aff.
झर्झरक: झर्झरक m. (-कः) The Kali yug. E. कन् added to the preceding.
झर्झरीक: झर्झरीक m. (-कः) 1 The body. 2 A country. 3 A picture. E. झर्झ to injure or destroy, ईकन् affix, and र inserted.
झलञ्झला: झलञ्झला f. (-ला) The flapping of an elephant's ears, of loose breasts, &c. the word is considered as merely imitative of the noise made.
झलरी: झलरी f. (-री) 1 A sort of drum. 2 A curl. E. झल imitative sound, र from रा to get or make, affix ड and ङीप्; also झल्लरी and झल्ली.
झला: झला f. (-ला) 1 A daughter. 2 Sunshine, splendour, brilliant or glistering light. 3 A cricket; also झाला.
झल्ल: झल्ल m. (-ल्लः) A prize fighter, a cudgel player, a man of a tribe following such a profession; one of the degraded classes, being sprung from the outcaste Kṣatriya. E. जल to surround or embrace, ल added, and ज changed to झ.
झल्लक: झल्लक n. (-कं) Cymbals. E. झल्ल imitative sound, a clash, and क what emits, from कै to sound, affix ड.
झल्लकण्ठ: झल्लकण्ठ m. (-ण्ठः) A pigeon. E. झल्ल imitative sound, and कण्ठ a throat.
झल्लरी: झल्लरी f. (-री) 1 A sort of drum. 2 A curl, a lock of hair: see झलरी. 3 A ball, &c. of perfumed substances used for cleaning the hair. 4 Moisture. 5 Purity.
झल्लिका: झल्लिका f. (-का) 1 Light, splendour, lustre. 2 A rag or cloth used for applying colour or perfumes. 3 Dirt brought off the body by rubbing it with perfumes.
झल्ली: झल्ली f. (-ल्ली) A kind of drum: see झलरी.
झल्लोल: झल्लोल m. (-लः) A ball or protuberance at the lower end of a spindle.
झष: झष r. 1st cl. (-झषति) To kill or hurt. 2 To take. 3 To put on, to wear.
झष m. (-षः) 1 A fish. 2 The sign Pisces. 3 Heat, warmth. 4 A forest, a thicket. f. (-षा) A plant, (Hedysarum lagopodioides.) n. (-षं) Waste land. E. झष to injure, affix अच्.
झषकेतन: झषकेतन m. (-नः) A name of KANDARPA. E. झष a fish, and केतन a banner, who bears a fish on his banner.
झषाङ्क: झषाङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) A name of ANIRUDDHA, the son of KĀMA. E. झष a fish, and अङ्क a mark or symbol.
झषाशन: झषाशन m. (-नः) The gangetic porpoise. E. झष fish, and अशन food.
झषोदरी: झषोदरी f. (-री) A proper name, the mother of the poet VYĀSA. E. झष a fish, and उदर the belly: born from the belly of a fish.
झांकृत: झांकृत n. (-तं) A tinkling ornament worn on the toes or the feet. E. झां a jangling or jingling, and कृत made (by which.)
झाट: झाट m. (-टः) 1 An arbour, a bower, a place overgrown with creepers. 2 A wood, a thicket. 3 Cleaning sores or wounds. f. (-टा-टी) 1 Jasmine. 3 A plant, (Flacourtia cataphracta:) see झाट n. (-टं) A wood, a thicket. E. झट to be entangled, affix घञ्.
झाटल: झाटल m. (-लः) A kind of flower: see घण्टापाटलि. E. झाट a thicket. or bower, ला to make, affix ड.
झामक: झामक n. (-कं) A burnt or vitrified brick. E. झम to eat, affix ण्वुल, being fed upon by fire.
झामर: झामर m. (-रः) A small whetstone, used chiefly by housewives for sharpening their spindles, needles, &c. E. झाम eating, wearing away, from झम to eat, affix घञ्, and र what gets, from रा with ड aff.
झार्झर: झार्झर mf. (-रः-री) A tabor player, a drummer. E. झर्झर a cymbal, affix अण्; also with ठक् affix झार्झरिक.
झालरी: झालरी f. (-री) A kind of drum or tabor. E. झलरी the same, अण् pleonastic, aff.
झालि: झालि f. (-लिः) A sort of sour or unripe mangoes, fried with salt, mustard and asafœtida.
झावु: झावु m. (-वुः) A tree, (Tamarix Indica;) also with कन् added झावुक m. (-कः) and with a long final vowel झावू. m. (-वूः) the words are considered as irregular or foreign.
झिङ्गाक: झिङ्गाक m. (-कः) A sort of cucumber, (Luffa acutangula.)
झिङ्गिनी: झिङ्गिनी f. (-नी) 1 A torch, a firebrand. 2 A sort of cucumber, (Luffa acutangula.)
झिज्जी: झिज्जी f. (-ज्जी) A cricket: see झिल्ली.
झिञ्जिम: झिञ्जिम m. (-मः) A forest on fire.
झिण्टी: झिण्टी f. (-ण्टी) A shrub, (Barleria cristata.) E. झि imitative sound, रट to utter, affix अच्, deriv. irr.
झिरी: झिरी f. (-री) A cricket. E. झि imitative of the cricket's chirp, रा to make, affixes ड and ङीष्; also झिल्ली; also झिरिका, कन् being added; also इ pen. being made long झिरीका, or changed to उ, झिरुका; the first vowel also being lengthened झीरिका, and झीरुका, &c.
झिरुका: झिरुका f. (-का) A cricket: see the last.
झिल्लि: झिल्लि f. (-ल्लिः) 1 Cymbals. 2 A cricket. 3 Membrane: see झिल्ली.
झिल्लिका: झिल्लिका f. (-का) 1 A cricket. 2 The light of sunshine, strong light, splendour. 3 Dirt taken off the body in rubbing it with perfumes. 4 A cloth or rag used for applying colour, unguents, &c. 5 A cricket's cry. 6 Membrane, thin skin, parchment. E. झिल्ल for चिल्ल imitative sound, expressing the cricket's chirp, and ङीष् being added झिल्ली, and कन् again added झिल्लिका; also with the penultimate long झिल्लीका.
झिल्ली: झिल्ली f. (-ल्ली) 1 A cricket. 2 Sunshine, light, lustre. 3 The wick of a lamp. 4 A cloth or rag for applying unguents, colour, &c. 5 A musical instrument, cymbals. 6 Membrane. E. see the preceding.
झिल्लीकण्ठ: झिल्लीकण्ठ m. (-ण्ठः) A pigeon. E. झिल्ली a cricket, and कण्ठ the throat; chirping as it were in the throat.
झीरिका: झीरिका f. (-का) A cricket: see झिरी.
झीरुका: झीरुका f. (-का) A cricket: see झिरी.
झु: झु r. 1st cl. (झवते) To go or move.
झुण्ट: झुण्ट m. (-ण्टः) A shrub, a bush. E. झट to be entangled, affix अच्, नुम् augment, and the vowel changed to उ.
झूणि: झूणि f. (-णिः) 1 A kind of betel nut. 2 Heavenly annunciation of misfortunes.
झूमेरि: झूमेरि f. (-रिः) One of the Rāgiṇīs, or modes of music personified.
झूष: झूष r. 1st cl. (झूषति) To hurt or kill.
झॄ: झॄ r. 9th cl. (भृणाति) (ष) झॄष् r. 1st cl. (झीर्य्यति) To grow old, to become infirm with age, &c. to decay.
झोड: झोड m. (-डः) The betel nut tree.
झ्यु: झ्यु r. 1st cl. (झ्यवते) To go or move. ञ
